correctness.rationale: For J^3=0 the algebra is determined by the multiplication tensor on V=J/J^2, and algebra isomorphisms act diagonally on V⊗V. Monomializability is therefore equivalent to the kernel being a coordinate subspace. The dimension-1 and dimension-3 cases reduce to rank-one tensors, while the dimension-2 case is exactly the ruling/matched-secant geometry of the Segre quadric.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. General monomial-recognition theorems of Bardzell--Green and Mojiri are known, but targeted searches did not locate this complete two-generator short-local Segre criterion or the ten-type classification. Their full texts were not inspected, leaving a documented residual risk of an implicit specialization.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete, field-independent, basis-free recognition test in the smallest nontrivial local two-loop class and converts a general isomorphism-to-monomial question into rank and projective-quadric incidence tests.
